p: Lampton Road runs north from Hounslow's town centre, and Hounslow Central station on the Piccadilly line is on this stretch, so it's handy if you're coming in by Tube. The High Street and Treaty Centre are just a short walk south.

Hounslow is right next to Heathrow, so you'll see plenty of planes overhead, and the Piccadilly line runs straight into central London. For a bit of green, Hounslow Heath, with its nature reserve, is a short trip away, and Osterley Park, a big National Trust house and gardens, is close by too.
Royal Casino Slots is 18+ only, so bring ID if you look young.
